meta.title: Field service: dispatch, checklists and the invoice on site · Clafina
meta.description: A dispatch board that refuses double bookings, checklists on the technician's phone, parts from the van and the invoice made before leaving. The Field service pack.

hero.title: The right technician, the right steps, the bill before they leave.
hero.lede: Share out the day's jobs, follow the checklist on the phone, take parts from the van and finish with the customer's signature.

business.name: Brightwire Power and Cooling
business.about: A service firm with five technicians in vans, installing and repairing air conditioning, solar systems and electrics across Lagos.

dayTitle: A day at Brightwire Power and Cooling

moments.title: Sharing out the day
moments.problem: Fifteen jobs, five technicians, and nobody should be in two places at once.
moments.handles: The dispatch board shows jobs by technician and hour, with a list of jobs waiting for someone. Assigning a job sets the technician and the van. If two live jobs for the same technician would overlap, the board refuses and names the other job.

moments.title: An urgent call
moments.problem: Chief Ade rings: the inverter is faulty and there was no power all night.
moments.handles: Bisi at the desk makes a new job with the customer, the site, a time window, a priority and the checklist for its job type. Service areas say which technicians cover Lekki.

moments.title: Nobody has arrived
moments.problem: A socket job in Yaba opened at nine, and the customer is still waiting.
moments.handles: A job counts as late once the minutes you set have passed since its window opened and nobody is on site. The board shows each technician's last known position, and a late report from a phone that was offline never moves the pin backwards.

moments.title: On site, and what comes first
moments.problem: Ayo arrives at Mrs Ibe's house and needs to know where to start.
moments.handles: He marks the job en route, then on site. His phone shows the next required step not yet done. The job keeps the checklist version it started with, even if the template changes later.

moments.title: The battery reads low
moments.problem: The battery bank is below where it should be, and that means a return visit.
moments.handles: A checklist step can take a tick, a number, a photo, text or a part. A number outside its limits raises the step's follow-up job when this job is finished, and only once.

moments.title: A fuse from the van
moments.problem: A fuse has blown, and Ayo has spares in the van.
moments.handles: The part step issues the fuse from the van's stock, because a van is a stock location. If the van shows none, the part is still recorded as used with the reason, and the van is put right at the end of the day.

moments.title: Signed and billed before leaving
moments.problem: The work is done, and the customer should sign and be billed while Ayo is still there.
moments.handles: A job can be finished only when every required step is answered, the customer has signed if the checklist asks, and there is a payment reference or invoice lines. The invoice on site is the standard customer invoice, and the time on site goes to Ayo's timesheet.

moments.title: Planning tomorrow
moments.problem: Tomorrow's jobs need planning around traffic and the right skills, and customers want to know when to expect someone.
moments.handles: Routes are worked out for each van, jobs go to technicians with the right skills, and each customer is told their arrival window.

words.meaning: A visit to a customer's site. The pack calls a task a job.
The board where the day's jobs are given to technicians by the hour.
The time the customer expects someone. A job is late when the window has opened and nobody is on site.
The steps between assigned and done that the technician marks from the phone.
The steps a technician follows on a job type, kept as versions.
A return visit raised by a reading outside its limits.
A technician's vehicle, which is also a stock location for parts.
The charge for coming out to the site, on the invoice with labour and parts.

switchesTitle: What the Field service pack switches on

switchesOn.text: A Field service menu: dispatch and jobs for every day, checklists and service areas for setting up
Jobs as project tasks with a customer, a site, a window and a priority, from waiting to done
A dispatch board by technician and hour that refuses overlapping jobs and shows which are late
Checklists in versions, with steps that take a tick, number, photo, text or part
Follow-up jobs raised by a reading outside its limits
Parts issued from the van's own stock
Photos for each step and the customer's signature, kept as files
Finishing with a payment reference or an invoice made on site
Technicians' last known positions on a map
The phone keeps the true time of each photo, signature and finish, even when it sends them later
Jobs on the phone with no signal at all, sent when it is back
Routes worked out for each van
Technicians' skills matched to each job
The customer told their arrival window

sharesTitle: What it shares with the rest of Clafina

shares.text: Every job is a project task, so its status and its hours move together, and time on site goes to timesheets.
Vans are stock locations, so a part used on a job leaves the van's count.
The invoice on site is the standard customer invoice.
The technician's phone and the dispatch board see each change as it happens.

modulesTitle: The parts of Clafina a service firm uses

faq.q: Can a technician be booked on two jobs at once?
faq.a: No. If two live jobs for the same technician would overlap, the board refuses and names the other job.

faq.q: How do I know a job is late?
faq.a: A job is late once the minutes you set have passed since its window opened and nobody is on site.

faq.q: What if the van has run out of the part?
faq.a: The part is still recorded as used, with the reason, and the van is put right at the end of the day.

faq.q: Can the customer pay on the spot?
faq.a: The technician makes the invoice on site and records the payment reference before finishing the job.

faq.q: Does the checklist change for jobs already started?
faq.a: No. A job keeps the version it started with. A new version applies to jobs made after you save it.

faq.q: Does the phone work where there is no signal?
faq.a: Working on a job with no signal at all, and sending it later, is on the way.

cta.title: Send your first job from Clafina.
cta.body: Start free, switch on the Field service pack and add your vans and checklists. Add technicians and service areas as you grow.
